## 設定した監査範囲

| enum | 必須経路 |
| --- | --- |
| <code>emela_lir::Value</code> | sync, suspend |
| <code>emela_lir::Stmt</code> | sync, suspend |
| <code>emela_lir::Term</code> | sync, suspend |
| <code>emela_lir::Callee</code> | sync, suspend |
| <code>emela_lir::OnFail</code> | sync, suspend |
| <code>emela_lir::SwitchOn</code> | sync, suspend |
| <code>emela_lir::CaseKey</code> | sync, suspend |
| <code>emela_lir::Const</code> | common |
| <code>emela_lir::Operand</code> | common |
| <code>emela_lir::PrimOp</code> | common |
| <code>emela_lir::PrimTy</code> | common |
| <code>emela_lir::RuntimeOp</code> | common |
| <code>emela_lir::Repr</code> | common |
| <code>emela_lir::Stage</code> | input |
| <code>emela_core::Builtin</code> | common |
| <code>emela_core::FiberOp</code> | sync, suspend |

入力禁止は設定に明示したIDと拒否routeの構文上の根拠を照合する。Flow許可の自動判定、変換先までの経路追跡、cfg評価、macro展開、関数型の解決、試験実行、レビュー済みhashの自動更新は行わない。
